changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionRollupPath') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPath] ( [Uid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [RollupPathUid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [AssetVersionUid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [FilterMatchType] int NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetVersionRollupPath] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_MetricRollupPath') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPath] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_MetricRollupPath] FOREIGN KEY([RollupPathUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[RollupPath] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPath] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_MetricRollupPath] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_MetricAssetVersion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPath] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_MetricAssetVersion] FOREIGN KEY([AssetVersionUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[AssetVersion] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPath] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_MetricAssetVersion] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_AssetVersion') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath_AssetVersion ON [metrics].AssetVersionRollupPath ( AssetVersionUid ASC ) END
